description:
TruePoint Calibration Labs, LLC (Charlotte, NC) is an ISO/IEC 17025:2017 accredited calibration laboratory (A2LA Certificate #4521). Calibration Technician Marcus Okafor has completed calibration of 4 instruments for client Southeastern Chemical Processing, Inc. He needs to create the formal calibration certificate package.

Read the calibration data file at /home/ga/Documents/calibration_data.json which contains the lab information, client details, and complete calibration results for 4 instruments:
1. Fluke 87V Digital Multimeter (S/N: 27340089) — DC Voltage and Resistance measurements
2. Omega HH42A Thermocouple Thermometer (S/N: TC-88712) — Temperature measurements at 5 points
3. Ashcroft 2089 Pressure Gauge (S/N: PG-445601) — Pressure measurements ascending and descending
4. Mettler Toledo ML3002E Precision Balance (S/N: B912004567) — Mass measurements at 5 points

Create a professional calibration certificate package document in Apache OpenOffice Writer that includes:
- A cover page with the lab name, accreditation number, client name, and package number (SCP-2024-0147)
- Four individual calibration certificates (one per instrument), each containing instrument identification, calibration and due dates, environmental conditions, a measurement data table with nominal values/as-found/as-left/tolerances/pass-fail, reference standard traceability, and uncertainty of measurement statement
- Use Heading 1 paragraph style for each certificate title and the cover page title (at least 5 total)
- Use Heading 2 paragraph style for subsections within certificates such as Instrument Details, Measurement Data, Traceability, Uncertainty (at least 8 total)
- Include at least 4 tables (measurement data tables with the numerical readings from the JSON)
- Include all 4 instrument serial numbers in the document text

Save the completed document as /home/ga/Documents/CalCert_Package_SCP_2024_0147.odt
